title: Potassium–bicarbonate coupling fails to improve cross-cycle resting-pulse prediction beyond flexible marginal measures
abstract: In NHANES 2005–06 to 2009–10 adult complete cases, a potassium × bicarbonate term worsened target resting-pulse MSE by 0.354548 bpm²; source-refit/target-PSU 95% interval [-0.104818, 1.466802]. This does not support incremental predictive utility.
